privateHeaders.X-Collection-Account: authenticated account UUID on every request

id: UUID collection id; immutable cp1_UUID printing ids

routes.response: collection full record plus ownership; idempotent id + original payload
collection full record including cardKeys and ownership

idempotency: Reuse mutationId(UUID) for retries. If absent, exact normalized operation payload including expectedRevision deterministically identifies the request. Successful replay returns replayed:true and acceptedRevision; current collection may have a later revision.
ownershipRule: manual mark OR exact verified single-print SNKRDUNK link and this account's positive-qty raw/psa9/psa10 holding. Never box. Membership/manual marks never write holdings or transactions.
storage: One atomic collections row with items_json and revision; private user_card_states; durable collection_mutations receipts. Snapshot create validates all explicit keys before one INSERT. No partial list.

runtimeFlags.COLLECTIONS_LAZY_SCHEMA: authenticated additive schema bootstrap is on by default; 0 or false requires supplied migration first

validation: Current catalogVersion required for create/items/ownership writes; ordinary private requests read the small manifest.json only. Artist/character snapshot create additionally loads catalog.json and requires matching version/readOnly. Character sourceOnly keys are rejected unless their trusted registry characterDiscoveryVerified is the exact boolean true and the key is also in the selected character scope. All sourceOnly keys remain excluded from automatic holdings ownership. Only trusted same-origin static catalog and registry are accepted; no session cookie/auth header is forwarded to static asset fetches. Same-origin/binding old shard versions are evicted and cache is limited to 16 shards.
limitations: Missing-price totals are not implemented by these endpoints.
D1 staging and production verification remain required.
Deletion keeps an owner-private tombstone and operation receipts for retry safety until account deletion.
legacyAccountCompatibility: JWT subjects accept existing nonempty string IDs and nonzero safe-integer IDs; account boundary is normalized to string.
